g.data-name: Artwork / fitted bitmap, source preserved separately
COMMON / plain iron, single rule, square corner joints
Rarity / plain iron, single rule, square corner joints
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: An archive attendant sorts bundles and returns each
document to the place where it can be found. Quiet order
gives the royal office a dependable memory, saving crucial
words from the confusion of a crowded day.
